rare_regions.activation_trigger: Occurs when the instruction in EX stage is a memory read and the next instruction in ID stage depends on that memory value.
rare_regions.description: Detects load-use hazards which happen infrequently, only when a memory-read instruction is immediately followed by an instruction that uses the loaded value.

                 (fwd_a_sel==2'd1) ? exmem_alu_y :

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Triggered only when forwarding is required due to data dependencies, which is infrequent under typical instruction sequences.
rare_regions.description: Handles rare data forwarding cases to resolve hazards when EX stage operands depend on results from later pipeline stages.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Occurs only when a branch is taken, which is relatively infrequent compared to sequential instruction execution.
rare_regions.description: Controls program counter update for branch instructions; most instructions do not alter PC via branches.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Triggered when a branch, JAL, or JALR instruction is executed, which occurs less frequently than normal sequential instructions.
rare_regions.description: Handles rare branch target calculation and branch decision logic in the EX stage.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Occurs only on system reset, which is infrequent during normal operation.
rare_regions.description: Initializes all pipeline registers and control signals to safe default values during reset.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Triggered only when a load-use hazard is detected, which is relatively rare depending on instruction sequences.
rare_regions.description: Flushes the ID/EX pipeline register to prevent incorrect execution when a load-use hazard occurs.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Triggered when a branch is taken, flushing the EX stage pipeline register, which happens infrequently.
rare_regions.description: Clears EX stage pipeline registers on branch flush to maintain correct program flow.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Occurs when a write to the register file is attempted; specifically, the protection ensures that register x0 is never modified, which happens rarely since x0 writes are usually ignored by software.
rare_regions.description: Ensures that the zero register (x0) always reads as zero, a rare enforced hardware invariant in RISC-V architectures.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Executed whenever an instruction is decoded, but each branch of the assignment is rare relative to normal sequential instructions since only specific instruction types match each opcode.
rare_regions.description: Selects the correct immediate value based on instruction opcode; certain immediate types (e.g., B-type, J-type) are infrequently used.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Triggered only for R-type instructions with specific funct3/funct7 combinations, which are less frequent in typical workloads.
rare_regions.description: Determines the ALU operation for rare or specific R-type instructions based on funct3 and funct7 encoding.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Triggered only for I-type ALU instructions with specific funct3 (and funct7 for shift-right), which are uncommon compared to standard ALU operations.
rare_regions.description: Determines the ALU operation for rare I-type instructions, including shift-right variants, based on funct3 and funct7 encoding.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Triggered only when ALU executes less common operations like shifts, signed comparisons, pass-through, or special addition, which are less frequent than basic add/subtract/bitwise operations.
rare_regions.description: Handles rare ALU operations that do not occur in every instruction, covering shifts, signed comparisons, and special arithmetic cases.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Occurs only when branch instructions are evaluated, which is less frequent compared to sequential instruction execution.
rare_regions.description: Evaluates rare branch conditions based on funct3 and operand values to determine whether a branch is taken.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Triggered only when data forwarding is required due to dependencies between EX/MEM and ID/EX stage registers, which happens infrequently under typical instruction sequences.
rare_regions.description: Handles rare data forwarding cases to resolve hazards when EX stage operands depend on results from later pipeline stages.

rare_regions.rare_region_code:
always @(*) begin
        case (funct3)
            3'b000: begin
                case (addr)
                    2'b00: begin r_be=4'b0001; r_wdata={24'b0, rs2[7:0]}; end
                    2'b01: begin r_be=4'b0010; r_wdata={16'b0, rs2[7:0], 8'b0}; end
                    2'b10: begin r_be=4'b0100; r_wdata={8'b0, rs2[7:0], 16'b0}; end
                    default:begin r_be=4'b1000; r_wdata={rs2[7:0], 24'b0}; end
                endcase
            end
            3'b001: begin
                if (addr[1]==1'b0) begin
                    r_be = 4'b0011; r_wdata = {16'b0, rs2[15:0]};
                end else begin
                    r_be = 4'b1100; r_wdata = {rs2[15:0], 16'b0};
                end
            end
            default: begin
                r_be   = 4'b1111; r_wdata = rs2;
            end
        endcase
    end
rare_regions.activation_trigger: Occurs during store instructions when address alignment requires special byte enable and data shifting, which is infrequent compared to normal aligned accesses.
rare_regions.description: Handles rare byte- and half-word store alignment cases based on address and funct3, ensuring correct data placement in memory.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Occurs during load instructions that access byte or half-word subfields with non-aligned addresses, which is less common compared to aligned word accesses.
rare_regions.description: Handles rare byte- and half-word load alignment and sign/zero extension based on address and funct3.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Occurs only during system reset (rst is high), which happens infrequently compared to normal memory access cycles.
rare_regions.description: Initializes the entire memory array to zero on reset; rare because resets are infrequent during normal operation.

rare_regions.activation_trigger: Triggered when a data memory write occurs (dmem_req && dmem_we) with specific byte enables; partial writes are less frequent than full word writes.
rare_regions.description: Handles selective byte-wise writing to memory, rarely activated when only some bytes need updating.
